implementation_issues.description: baseline_accy: dependent_variable.definition: The source does not state how the multiple individual analyst forecasts are aggregated into the firm-year ACCY measure.

baseline_accy: equation_timing.LOG_MKT: Equation (4) indexes LOG_MKT at t, but the variable definitions specify market value of equity at the end of t+1; the extraction preserves both source statements.
baseline_accy: equation_timing.EL: Equation (4) indexes EL at t, but the variable definitions specify actual EPS for t+1; the extraction preserves both source statements.
baseline_accy: independent_variables[4].formula: The paper identifies the source score and parameter version but does not report its component inputs or formula.
baseline_accy: specifications.fixed_effects.details: The source reports industry and year fixed effects but does not identify the industry classification used in the outcome regression.

ps_accy: independent_variables: The paper prints a generic PROXY_CONTROLS block and says redundant controls are excluded, but does not identify which candidates were removed. Listed outcome controls are candidates and do not assert the exact post-exclusion RHS.

ps_accy: equation_timing.PROXY_CONTROLS: Equation (1) indexes the generic proxy-control block at t; Equation (4) indexes LOG_MKT and EL at t, while their variable definitions state t+1. The source does not reconcile these timings.
ps_accy: specifications.fixed_effects.details: The source reports industry and fiscal-year fixed effects but does not identify the industry classification.
